runtimeTopology.serverAuthority: Kumwe PHP application services and PHP HTTP endpoints

currentFallback.description: The model-first Blueprint canvas remains a transitional route bound to an existing Content type version. Contextual Content New/Edit authoring is the default surface; the structured form is the STUDIO-PROD-014 fallback.

acceptance.description: Acceptance is the maintainer merging after every automated check is green. There is no separate human qualification run: the automated evidence each step names is the whole record, and a step without it is open until evidence is added.

automatedEvidence.marker: closed layout intent renders four, two and one columns without surface overflow

steps.outcome: Content New mounts the compiled Studio module in place and swaps with the labelled structured-form fallback.

automatedEvidence.marker: the Studio page builder mounts on Content New and swaps with the structured form

steps.outcome: Mount a standalone and a hosted instance in one ordinary document; export, import and configured-refusal behaviour (STUDIO-PROD-015 steps 1 to 3).
steps.automationNote: Not automated in App: standalone mode is Studio-owned and App never mounts it. The Content surface is a hosted session, and ADR 0020 forbids turning a configured refusal into local mode, so the portable multi-instance mount is proven by the Studio package itself rather than by an App page.

steps.outcome: Start a clean production host using compiled Studio browser assets, PHP server authority and no Node.js, npm, Vite, development server or server-side JavaScript process.

automatedEvidence.marker: blank creation defines a typed field, saves a reusable type and saves its item in one session

steps.automationNote: Automated: compiled module with manifest integrity, PHP host ports only, no development-server or socket request (browser), plus tests/Architecture/StudioProductionRuntimeTest.php refusing Node.js, npm and Vite in images, services, entry points, install hooks and PHP processes. Not automated: authoring from a clean packaged start. The deployed-artifact lane runs without a database by design, and the production-topology job in .github/workflows/deployment-acceptance.yml does not yet drive a Studio session.

steps.outcome: Resolve one core target and one extension-owned target through the same generic declaration and open Studio from the exact existing item's normal content context; fullscreen only continues and returns to that context.

automatedEvidence.marker: the existing item reopens with its exact revisions, saves, and refuses a stale concurrent save

steps.automationNote: Core target automated from Content New/Edit. Not implemented: an extension-owned content area resolving through the same declaration. The extension SDK (manifest schema 6) declares block-definition, pattern, field-adapter, inspector, design-vocabulary and migration composition documents but no authoring-target kind, so an extension cannot declare a Studio target or bind its own resource authority; App declares one core target (kumwe.app/content-authoring) and must not invent a private declaration shape.

steps.outcome: Reopen an existing item and hydrate its exact reusable-type, Model, Blueprint and Entry revisions and its own values without substituting the latest type.

automatedEvidence.marker: the existing item reopens with its exact revisions, saves, and refuses a stale concurrent save

automatedEvidence.marker: the existing item reopens with its exact revisions, saves, and refuses a stale concurrent save

steps.automationNote: Automated for Entry values with save-item and reopen. A layout change is a reusable-type change under itemComposition=denied and is proven by save-new-type-version.

steps.outcome: Create from an authorized reusable content type and receive its exact layout, blocks, fields and bindings with empty Entry values.

automatedEvidence.marker: a new item from the reusable type receives its fields with empty values

steps.outcome: Create from a blank canvas, insert layout and content blocks, add or bind typed fields and enter values without leaving Studio or pre-creating another artifact.

automatedEvidence.marker: blank creation defines a typed field, saves a reusable type and saves its item in one session

steps.automationNote: Automated: blank start, typed field through the Model control, values, save. The pinned Studio release requires the type to exist before values are entered because a reusable-type save result must echo the live Entry the request does not carry.

steps.automationNote: Automated with visible dependent-entry and adoption consequences and immutable successor coordinates.

steps.outcome: Move through every declared inline, minimized, maximized and fullscreen state without losing resource coordinates, selection, history, dirty state, validation, authority, unsaved work or return context.

automatedEvidence.marker: blank creation defines a typed field, saves a reusable type and saves its item in one session

steps.automationNote: Automated for all four states with resource, mode and unsaved work retained, by pointer and by keyboard. The pinned Studio 0.1.0-beta.3 cannot save outside the presentation the session started in, because its save requests do not carry the presentation.

steps.outcome: Use authorized extension block-definition, field-adapter and pattern contributions, save and render, then prove deterministic disable, unresolved, upgrade and migration behavior.

automatedEvidence.marker: a layout change with an extension block saves an immutable successor type version

steps.automationNote: Automated: the admitted manifest-six grid block is inserted, configured through the inspector, saved into an immutable successor type version, previewed and publicly rendered in the browser journey. On every engine, tests/Integration/Studio/ContentStudioAuthoringJourneyIntegrationTest.php (testAnExtensionBlockIsAuthoredWithdrawnAndRestoredInTheContextualSession) installs and activates a signed manifest-six package, composes its grid into a new reusable type and saves an item; disabling the package withdraws the grid from the contextual catalogue while the item still opens with the unresolved grid preserved in its layout and lock and its values still save; a type save that could no longer lock the grid is refused (studio.authoring/unlocked-block); and an upgrade that keeps the exact block coordinates restores it. The App's canonical empty-section pattern, registered through the same contribution registrar as extension documents, is applied from the contextual palette by keyboard in the journey spec, and a Blueprint composing the section it creates is saved and locked in the integration journey. Not implemented: extension field-adapter use, because Content models carry no extension field kinds for an adapter to bind; extension pattern use, because the SDK fixture pattern depends on block types the fixture does not declare; and block-version migration, because no Kumwe App path applies a composition migration document and the SDK ships no fixture with a versioned block and its migration.

steps.outcome: Prove equivalent pointer, keyboard, structural-control, touch and required assistive-technology outcomes.

automatedEvidence.marker: the contextual shell is operable by keyboard alone with named controls in reading order

steps.automationNote: Automated on Chromium desktop and mobile: the WCAG 2.2 AA scan (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21aa, wcag22aa) on every state; keyboard-only entry through the skip link, the start chooser, the start, the presentations, the mode tabs, a typed field, a non-drag palette block insertion and the App's canonical pattern; an accessible name, visibility and reading order for every focus stop; focus returned to the region heading when the shell replaces the chooser; the same controls by tap on the touch-capable mobile project; and reflow at 320 CSS pixels without horizontal scrolling. The Hebrew and Arabic projects repeat the keyboard walk with localized names in tests/Browser/studio-authoring-right-to-left.spec.ts.

steps.outcome: Run the contextual shell in a translated interface language, including right-to-left, with every control named in that language and no horizontal overflow.

automatedEvidence.marker: the contextual Studio shell runs right-to-left with localized names and keyboard operation

steps.automationNote: Automated on the desktop and mobile Hebrew and Arabic projects: right-to-left document and shell direction, the shell header, the host return label and the App's own palette blocks and pattern named from the locale catalogue, right-to-left header order, arrow-key mode tabs, the WCAG 2.2 AA scan and zero horizontal overflow. The full journey takes its interface locale from KUMWE_STUDIO_JOURNEY_LOCALE. The pinned Studio 0.1.0-beta.3 renders its create-source chooser and save-confirmation chrome without catalogue overrides; host-authored consequences inside that confirmation are localized.

steps.outcome: Record that every durable effect passed through authenticated, authorized, validated, transactional, versioned and audited Kumwe PHP APIs and application services.

automatedEvidence.marker: the accepted item previews through the authenticated channel and renders publicly once published

steps.automationNote: Automated: every host call is a same-origin POST to the PHP host-port endpoint with the CSRF header; integration tests prove audit and idempotent replay.
